confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'most likely developing an electrical leakage fault' and 'very likely the RCD' are hedged

rationale: The assistant correctly told the customer to stop using the hob, keep it isolated and get an electrician or appliance engineer to test it, and it never recommended a part. It used the customer's details (RCD-type switch, boil-overs, faint smell) sensibly. Weaknesses are the leaning toward 'earth leakage' with some false certainty ('this is not a normal overload'), the repeated stop-use and inspect instructions, and asking the customer to make external inspections rather than asking more targeted questions. The second reply also misstates the smell as 'burning or hot-plastic' when the customer said only 'faint electrical smell'.
